title: Juicy Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A briny and silky post-workout Syrian dish featuring chicken marinated in a mixture of Appleton rum, pickle juice, and spices, this recipe is diabetic-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of flavors and textures creates a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Appleton rum, pickle juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Brush the chicken with lemon juice during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with additional lemon wedges if desired.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
